levels.surface: أبو عبد الله محمد بن خالد

notes: «قراءة» after the Hasan b. al-Qasim link is a manner of reading, not a name
«أبيه» and «جده» are bare relations, so they are relation links with no name
the scene in which Amir al-Mu'minin speaks is the saying; the last named transmitter is Ali b. al-Husayn
